_doc: BBB v2 chunk B — sub-IG / fallen-angel hospital muni obligors. 8 distressed names where covenant pressure signals should fire strongly. Includes ACTUAL covenant breach evidence for Butler Health (DSCR -2.28x FY23 / 0.39x FY24 vs 1.10x covenant), John Fitzgibbon (DSCR <1.00 vs 1.25 covenant FY ended 4/30/2023 with formal waiver Aug 30 2023), and Northern Light (DSCR covenant violations 2022 and 2024). These are gold-standard verification cases.
_methodology: WebSearch + WebFetch against (1) rating-agency press releases via Bond Buyer/Becker's, (2) local trade press (Butler Eagle, Bangor Daily News, Buffalo News, Norman Transcript), (3) obligor IR pages + state regulatory archives (Oklahoma State Auditor for Norman Regional public hospital authority), (4) direct PDF extraction via pdftotext where binary content surfaced (CHLA FY2024 consolidated financial statements from fdpclearinghouse.org). For Butler Health, the Butler Eagle Nov 2024 forbearance article quoted the 1.10x covenant verbatim alongside the breach values.

_confidence_definitions.HIGH: Direct from MTI / Official Statement / audited financials / continuing disclosure with verbatim numeric covenant or actual value
_confidence_definitions.MEDIUM: Rating-agency report or trade press summary quoting the specific value for THIS obligor
_confidence_definitions.LOW: Industry-typical default applied (no verified source for this obligor's specific covenant)

days_cash_on_hand_minimum.citation_text: CHLA FY2024 consolidated financial statements (year ended June 30, 2024) Note 13 discloses the Master Indenture covenant package: 'requires the Hospital to maintain an annual long-term debt service coverage ratio of at least 1.10x. The Hospital complied with all covenant requirements pursuant to the Master Indenture at June 30, 2024 and 2023.' No explicit DCOH covenant value disclosed in the Master Indenture per FY24 audit — the operative covenant is the 1.10x DSCR.
days_cash_on_hand_minimum._warning: Master Indenture per FY24 audit does NOT contain a stated days-cash-on-hand floor — only the 1.10x DSCR covenant. Bank covenants in line of credit ($50M outstanding at FYE24) may contain DCOH but were not surfaced in audit.

debt_service_coverage_minimum.citation_text: Master Indenture (Series 2017 + Series 2022 bonds via California Health Facilities Financing Authority): 'requires the Hospital to maintain an annual long-term debt service coverage ratio of at least 1.10x'. Verbatim from CHLA FY2024 consolidated financial statements Note 13.

additional_covenants.name: Moody's Baa2 -> Ba2 / S&P BBB -> BB+ — fallen angel chronology
additional_covenants.description: S&P Nov 4, 2024 BBB -> BBB- (CreditWatch Negative); Moody's Dec 2024 outlook revision Baa2 to Negative; S&P Feb 2025 BBB- -> BB+ (crossed IG/sub-IG); Moody's May 2025 Baa2 -> Baa3; Moody's late 2025 Baa3 -> Ba1; Moody's 2026 Ba1 -> Ba2. Operating cash flow margin only 1.1% YTD per April 2026 Bond Buyer.

operating_metrics._notes: FY24 audited: Total revenues $1,740,740K; total expenses before D&A&I $1,719,027K; EBITDA $21,713K; D&A&I $99,385K; DEFICIT OF REVENUES OVER EXPENSES $(77,672)K; deficit incl other gains $(62,950)K. Operating margin computed = (21,713 - 99,385)/1,740,740 = -4.5% before other gains; -3.6% post other gains. DCOH 164 days at 6/30/2024 (DOWN from 212 days at 6/30/2023). LT debt $434.9M revenue bonds + $50M LOC = $484.9M total. Investment income $34.2M. NOTE: DCOH has since collapsed to ~17 days by Dec 2025 per Bond Buyer Apr 2026 (post-FY24).

Children's Hospital Los Angeles._notes: CHLA Master Indenture has ONLY a 1.10x DSCR covenant — NO DCOH covenant. This means the standard hospital-MTI covenant tripwire model (which assumes ~65 DCOH floor) underestimates the actual covenant cushion in CHLA's case. The covenant tripwire on CHLA fires on DSCR not DCOH. FY24 audited DCOH 164 days BUT FY25 reporting shows collapse to 17 days by Dec 2025 — that's the deterioration vector.

Butler Health System._notes: Butler Health System is the GOLD-STANDARD covenant-breach test case alongside John Fitzgibbon. ACTUAL VERIFIED breach values: 1.10x DSCR covenant, DSCR -2.28x FY23, DSCR 0.39x FY24. Forbearance Dec 2024 — covenant signal should have fired LONG before forbearance executed. Subsequent fallen angel: Moody's Baa2 -> Ba1 + Fitch BBB -> BB+ over 2023-2024 = 5 downgrades across 2 agencies in 24mo. Pennsylvania conduit: Butler County Hospital Authority.

_patterns_observed.covenant_existence_pattern_critical: Two obligors in chunk B explicitly do NOT have the typical hospital-MTI covenant structure: (1) Regional West Health Services — Series 2016A bonds have NO DCOH covenant per Fitch verbatim, despite 14 days actual DCOH that would otherwise breach. (2) Children's Hospital LA — Master Indenture has ONLY a 1.10x DSCR covenant, NO DCOH floor. This means the covenant tripwire signal model must check covenant EXISTENCE before firing a 'covenant breach' alert — false positives are possible if model assumes all hospital obligors have the standard 65/1.10x package.
_patterns_observed.fallen_angel_chronology_pattern: All 4 fallen-angel obligors crossed the IG/sub-IG boundary in 2023-2024: Butler (Fitch Dec 2024 BB+), Northern Light (Moody's 2024 multi-notch, S&P Feb 2025), CHLA (S&P Feb 2025 BB+; first Moody's downgrade May 2025 was just-after-window), Norman Regional (already Ba1 entering but fell to B1 Nov 2024 and Caa2 2025). The covenant signal must fire BEFORE the public rating action — i.e. when the audited DSCR / DCOH first deteriorates materially.
_patterns_observed.rural_safety_net_signature: John Fitzgibbon (rural MO, $63M revenue), Regional West (rural NE, $350M revenue), Norman Regional (regional OK, $500M revenue, public hospital authority) share: small absolute size, single-hospital or near-single, payer mix heavily Medicaid, capital project overruns / capex burden, governance turnover. Distinct profile from large urban safety-net (Catholic Health Buffalo, BMC from chunk A) where FEMA/state support can drive turnaround.
_patterns_observed.data_quality_pattern: Trade press (Butler Eagle, Becker's, Bangor Daily News) yielded better verbatim covenant data for breach cases than for compliant cases — because breach forces disclosure. Reorg / Octus covers DSCR negative ratios on EMMA-disclosed continuing disclosures. State auditor PDFs (Oklahoma for Norman Regional) timed out via WebFetch within session budget.

_chunk_b_completion_summary._notes: John Fitzgibbon and Butler Health System are the gold-standard covenant-breach test cases (HIGH confidence DSCR covenant + breach values + dates). Northern Light is a STRONG breach case (DSCR violations 2022+2024 per Moody's verbatim). CHLA has HIGH confidence covenant (1.10x DSCR Master Indenture) but was COMPLIED at FY24 — the signal should fire on the trajectory (FY25 DCOH 17 days vs FY24 164 days = 90% decline). Regional West and CHLA both teach the same lesson: covenant existence varies and must be verified before tripwire fires.
